tasks.label: CodeMender: Scan Current File
tasks.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && cm find ${file} --model gemini-3.8-flash --format sarif --output ${workspaceFolder}/.sarif/findings.sarif -y

tasks.label: CodeMender: Scan Entire Workspace
tasks.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && cm find ${workspaceFolder} --model gemini-3.8-flash --format sarif --output ${workspaceFolder}/.sarif/findings.sarif -y
